arguments:
set -euo pipefail
R=/home/ubuntu/rea-final-runtime
E=/home/ubuntu/rea-original-upstream-680
test -x "$R/bin/rea-mcp"
test -f "$E/scripts/rea.mjs"
test -f "$R/docs/OPERATIONS.md"
printf 'REA_LOCAL_ENTRYPOINT=pass\n'
printf 'REA_ORIGINAL_ENGINE=pass\n'
expected=d033dc2c947c601d9161b2a48d3f34b5f488a769
actual="$(git hash-object "$R/docs/OPERATIONS.md")"
printf 'REA_RUNTIME_OPERATIONS_BLOB=%s\n' "$actual"
test "$actual" = "$expected"
echo 'REA_RUNTIME_OPERATIONS_SYNC=pass'
for f in "$R/vendors/providers/node-v24.22.1/bin/node" "$R/vendors/tools/jdk-21/bin/java" "$R/vendors/tools/ghidra_12.1.4_PUBLIC" "$R/vendors/tools/jadx-headless-mcp-0.7.1-all.jar" "$R/vendors/providers/binwalk-3.1.0/bin/binwalk"; do
 if test -e "$f"; then printf 'PROVIDER_PATH_PRESENT=%s\n' "$(basename "$f")"; else printf 'PROVIDER_PATH_NOT_PRESENT=%s\n' "$(basename "$f")"; fi
done
echo 'REA_PORTABLE_READONLY_CHECK=pass'
